schema.text: Do you rarely walk because the streets are uncomfortable for walking (sidewalks, shade, benches)?

ar.#Do you rarely walk because the streets: هل تعود قلّة مشيك إلى أن الشوارع غير مريحة للمشي (الأرصفة، الظل، المقاعد)؟

de.#Do you rarely walk because the streets: Gehen Sie selten zu Fuß, weil die Straßen zum Gehen unbequem sind (Gehwege, Schatten, Bänke)?

en.#Do you rarely walk because the streets: Do you rarely walk because the streets are uncomfortable for walking (sidewalks, shade, benches)?

fa.#Do you rarely walk because the streets: آیا کم پیاده‌روی می‌کنید چون خیابان‌ها برای پیاده‌روی راحت نیستند (پیاده‌رو، سایه، نیمکت)؟

fr.#Do you rarely walk because the streets: Marchez-vous rarement parce que les rues sont peu agréables pour marcher (trottoirs, ombre, bancs) ?

hu.#Do you rarely walk because the streets: Azért jár ritkán gyalog, mert az utcák kényelmetlenek a gyalogláshoz (járdák, árnyék, padok)?

it.#Do you rarely walk because the streets: Cammini poco perché le strade sono scomode per camminare (marciapiedi, ombra, panchine)?

tr.#Do you rarely walk because the streets: Sokaklar yürümeye elverişli olmadığı için mi (kaldırımlar, gölge, banklar) nadiren yürüyorsunuz?
